why: No placeholder fills (Creatomate's template_id enterTemplateID stays as written: the fixture answers the render whatever the body says). See timeCompression.

timeCompression.why: Wait1 and Wait6 wait 30 seconds (amount 30, unit left at the Wait v1.1 default of seconds); Wait2 and Wait4 wait 3 minutes. Together that is over six minutes of waiting per related article. All four are shortened to 1 second on both sides. This changes when the run resumes, not what it does: the Leonardo and Runway mocks answer by generation or task id, not by elapsed time, and no expression in the template reads $now. Not a placeholder fill, so results flag it as time compression (config.nonPlaceholder).
